sentences.text:
Shri Sanjay K.
Agrawal - Senior Advocate with Shri Rahul Rawat - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Akshay Namdev - Government Advocate for the State.
Also heard on I.A. No.15155/2024, which is the first application filed on behalf of the applicant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

Being aggrieved by the judgment and sentence dated 14.06.2024 passed by Ist Additional Sessions Judge, Katni passed in Cr.A. No.34/2024 whereby the learned Appellate Court has partly allowed the appeal of the applicant and modifying the judgment and sentence passed by JMFC Katni in Criminal Case No.144/2010 on 03.02.2024.

The applicant was convicted by the trial Court under Section 7 r/w Section 16(1)(ka)(i) Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo R.I. for six months with fine of Rs.1000/- with default stipulation.

Learned Senior Advocate for the applicant has submitted that the Courts below have not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the applicant for aforesaid offence.
The applicant is in custody and there is a bleak possibility of disposal of this revision in near future, therefore, the sentence of the applicant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.

Looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case, I find it to be a fit case to suspend the jail sentence of the applicant and to release him on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, this application is allowed.

I t is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the jail sentence of applicant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail for securing his presence before the trial Court concerned Subhash Pillai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5170697/
1 on 02.09.2024 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of this case.
List for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy as per rules.
(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE shahina Subhash Pillai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5170697/
